job.title: Delivery Operations Manager
job.snippet:
About The Role
We’re looking for a Delivery Operations Manager to own the day-to-day execution of Hermes production. Hermes is our playable ads production team, working in a fast-moving, technical, AI-driven environment with internally developed tools.
In this role, your main focus will be keeping production stable, clear, and moving. You’ll ensure teams, tasks, resources, and priorities are aligned so playable production flows smoothly from onboarding through delivery. This is a hands-on execution role for someone highly organized, proactive, technically oriented, and comfortable working in a constantly evolving production environment.
Responsibilities:
Key Responsibilities
Production Execution and Flow
Own the day-to-day execution flow of playable production and keep delivery moving.
Keep production priorities and team alignment tied to business needs and delivery commitments.
Act as the production gatekeeper: clear blockers and make sure required inputs are in place on time.
Maintain a clear, reliable view of active production status, ownership, deadlines, risks and blockers.
Give regular operational updates so stakeholders stay aligned and don't need to chase.
Find friction in the production pipeline and suggest practical fixes that improve speed, clarity and delivery quality.
Maintain the operational workflows that support quality assurance and reduce bottlenecks.
Work with Product, Tech and Customer Success to adopt new workflows, automations and internal tool improvements.
Requirements:
What We're Looking For
2+ years of experience in operations, production, project management or a similar execution-focused role, ideally in gaming, advertising or media.
Experience managing day-to-day work across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Experience with project management tools (Monday.com, Asana, Jira or ClickUp).
Highly organized: you manage priorities, deadlines, ownership and follow-ups without dropping things.
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to flag gaps, inconsistencies and risks early.
A problem-solving mindset and quick, proactive decision-making.
Comfortable working with reports, dashboards and status tracking, and in an environment of internal tools and AI-driven workflows.
Clear communication, written and spoken. You'll keep teams aligned and stakeholders updated.
Fluent English, written and spoken. You'll lead meetings, write documentation and work with global team members.
Working days: Monday to Friday (10:00-19:00) to align with our global teams.
Bonus Points
Experience in mobile gaming, playable ads, creative production or performance marketing.
Experience working with Product and Tech teams on internal tools, automations or workflow improvements.
Experience in a startup, and the ability to adapt to shifting priorities.

job.title: בימאי/ת ראשי/ת ומנהל/ת קריאייטיב של כאן – פטור ממכרז
job.snippet:
מספר משרה: 16831 אזור המרכז משרה מלאה משרות פנויות
פרטי משרה
הנראות של תוכנית הטלוויזיה של כאן היא חלק בלתי נפרד מהסיפור שלה!
אנחנו מחפשים בימאי/ת ראשי/ת, מנהל/ת קריאייטיב שיידע/תדע לחבר בין תוכן, עיצוב וטכנולוגיה, וליצור נראות אולפנית שמחזקת את התוכן, מעשירה את חוויית הצפייה ומשתלבת בשפה העיצובית של כאן. העבודה במסגרת חטיבת הנראות השידורית, הקריאייטיב והפרומו של כאן, תאגיד השידור הישראלי.
מה תעשו אצלנו?
תובילו את הקו הקריאייטיבי ואת הנראות האולפנית של תוכניות האולפן הלא חדשותיות בכאן, משלב גיבוש הקונספט ועד ליישומו על המסך.
תפתחו פתרונות עיצוביים לאולפנים ולפריימים, בהתאמה לאופי התוכנית, לתוכן ולשפה העיצובית הכללית של כאן.
תעבדו מול חברות ההפקה, תיתנו מענה לצרכים הקריאטיביים והעיצוביים ותלוו את יישום הפתרונות בימי צילום, בפיילוטים ובסטים.
תבחנו ותשלבו פתרונות וטכנולוגיות, שיכולים להרחיב את האפשרויות העיצוביות ולשפר את הנראות על המסך ובזרועות שידור נוספות של התאגיד.
מה אנחנו מחפשים?
חשיבה יצירתית ויכולת לפתח קונספטים ופתרונות עיצוביים חדשניים.
הבנה עמוקה של השפה הטלוויזיונית, קומפוזיציה ופריימינג, רגישות לנראות על המסך ותשומת לב לפרטים.
אוריינטציה טכנולוגית, היכרות עם טכנולוגיות ומערכות רלוונטיות ונכונות וסקרנות להתעדכן בחידושים בתחום.
יכולת להוביל תהליכים מקצועיים ולעבוד בשיתוף פעולה עם גורמים שונים בתוך התאגיד ומחוצה לו.
אהבה לטלוויזיה, סקרנות, חדשנות ויכולת לחבר בין רעיונות יצירתיים לאפשרויות ביצועיות.
תנאי הסף
ניסיון של 4 שנים לפחות כארט דיירקטור/ית ו/או מעצב ראשי בתוכניות אולפן בטלוויזיה, או ניסיון של 4 שנים לפחות כבמאי/ת תוכניות אולפן בטלוויזיה (לצורך כך, ייחשב ניסיון מ-10 השנים האחרונות בלבד).
בעת הגשת המועמדות יש לצרף קישור לתיק עבודות רלוונטי. רק מועמדים שתיק העבודות שלהם יימצא מתאים יוזמנו להמשך התהליך.
תנאים נוספים המהווים יתרון
ניסיון של שנתיים לפחות בעבודה עם טאלנטים ו/או צוות סטיילינג.
ניסיון בניהול שידור טלוויזיוני חי.
תנאי המשרה
ההעסקה במשרה מלאה. תיתכן אפשרות לשינוי בהיקף המשרה כפוף לצרכי המערכת.
הגיוס למשרה פטור ממכרז - בחירת המועמד תיעשה על בסיס שיקולים עניינים ומקצועיים וללא משוא פנים. התאגיד אינו מתחייב לזמן לראיון מי מהפונים. לא תישלח הודעה כלשהי למועמדים/ות שהגישו מועמדות למשרה, למעט אם הוחלט לזמנם לריאיון.
אתר העבודה: אור יהודה. תידרש הגעה לימי צילומים ואתרים נוספים ולפי הצורך עבודה ביתר מתקני התאגיד.
מועד אחרון להגשת מועמדות: 28.10.2026
המודעה מיועדת לגברים ולנשים כאחד.
נדרשת שליטה בשפה העברית.
יש להגיש את המועמדות למשרה בצירוף קובץ קורות חיים עדכני ואישורים רלוונטיים ולאחר שנבדקה העמידה בתנאי הסף.
למטרת ייצוג הולם בתאגיד השידור הישראלי, בגיוס למשרה זו תינתן עדיפות למועמדים הבאים: בני האוכלוסייה הערבית, לרבות הדרוזית והצ'רקסית, מי שהוא או שאחד מהוריו נולדו באתיופיה, נשים, בני האוכלוסייה החרדית, עולים חדשים, אנשים עם מוגבלות - בהתאם להוראות והגדרות חוק שירות המדינה (מינויים), התשי"ט-1959. עדיפות למועמדים תינתן גם בהתאם להוראות ההסכם הקיבוצי של התאגיד מיום 31.3.24. לאוכלוסייה הזכאית לייצוג הולם - כדי לקבל את ההעדפה, יש לציין בעת הגשת המועמדות את דבר ההשתייכות לאוכלוסייה זו בשדה המתאים.

מספר משרה: 16831 אזור המרכז משרה מלאה משרות פנויות
פרטי משרה
הנראות של תוכנית הטלוויזיה של כאן היא חלק בלתי נפרד מהסיפור שלה!
אנחנו מחפשים בימאי/ת ראשי/ת, מנהל/ת קריאייטיב שיידע/תדע לחבר בין תוכן, עיצוב וטכנולוגיה, וליצור נראות אולפנית שמחזקת את התוכן, מעשירה את חוויית הצפייה ומשתלבת בשפה העיצובית של כאן. העבודה במסגרת חטיבת הנראות השידורית, הקריאייטיב והפרומו של כאן, תאגיד השידור הישראלי.
מה תעשו אצלנו?
תובילו את הקו הקריאייטיבי ואת הנראות האולפנית של תוכניות האולפן הלא חדשותיות בכאן, משלב גיבוש הקונספט ועד ליישומו על המסך.
תפתחו פתרונות עיצוביים לאולפנים ולפריימים, בהתאמה לאופי התוכנית, לתוכן ולשפה העיצובית הכללית של כאן.
תעבדו מול חברות ההפקה, תיתנו מענה לצרכים הקריאטיביים והעיצוביים ותלוו את יישום הפתרונות בימי צילום, בפיילוטים ובסטים.
תבחנו ותשלבו פתרונות וטכנולוגיות, שיכולים להרחיב את האפשרויות העיצוביות ולשפר את הנראות על המסך ובזרועות שידור נוספות של התאגיד.
מה אנחנו מחפשים?
חשיבה יצירתית ויכולת לפתח קונספטים ופתרונות עיצוביים חדשניים.
הבנה עמוקה של השפה הטלוויזיונית, קומפוזיציה ופריימינג, רגישות לנראות על המסך ותשומת לב לפרטים.
אוריינטציה טכנולוגית, היכרות עם טכנולוגיות ומערכות רלוונטיות ונכונות וסקרנות להתעדכן בחידושים בתחום.
יכולת להוביל תהליכים מקצועיים ולעבוד בשיתוף פעולה עם גורמים שונים בתוך התאגיד ומחוצה לו.
אהבה לטלוויזיה, סקרנות, חדשנות ויכולת לחבר בין רעיונות יצירתיים לאפשרויות ביצועיות.
תנאי הסף
ניסיון של 4 שנים לפחות כארט דיירקטור/ית ו/או מעצב ראשי בתוכניות אולפן בטלוויזיה, או ניסיון של 4 שנים לפחות כבמאי/ת תוכניות אולפן בטלוויזיה (לצורך כך, ייחשב ניסיון מ-10 השנים האחרונות בלבד).
בעת הגשת המועמדות יש לצרף קישור לתיק עבודות רלוונטי. רק מועמדים שתיק העבודות שלהם יימצא מתאים יוזמנו להמשך התהליך.
תנאים נוספים המהווים יתרון
ניסיון של שנתיים לפחות בעבודה עם טאלנטים ו/או צוות סטיילינג.
ניסיון בניהול שידור טלוויזיוני חי.
תנאי המשרה
ההעסקה במשרה מלאה. תיתכן אפשרות לשינוי בהיקף המשרה כפוף לצרכי המערכת.
הגיוס למשרה פטור ממכרז - בחירת המועמד תיעשה על בסיס שיקולים עניינים ומקצועיים וללא משוא פנים. התאגיד אינו מתחייב לזמן לראיון מי מהפונים. לא תישלח הודעה כלשהי למועמדים/ות שהגישו מועמדות למשרה, למעט אם הוחלט לזמנם לריאיון.
אתר העבודה: אור יהודה. תידרש הגעה לימי צילומים ואתרים נוספים ולפי הצורך עבודה ביתר מתקני התאגיד.
מועד אחרון להגשת מועמדות: 28.10.2026
המודעה מיועדת לגברים ולנשים כאחד.
נדרשת שליטה בשפה העברית.
יש להגיש את המועמדות למשרה בצירוף קובץ קורות חיים עדכני ואישורים רלוונטיים ולאחר שנבדקה העמידה בתנאי הסף.
למטרת ייצוג הולם בתאגיד השידור הישראלי, בגיוס למשרה זו תינתן עדיפות למועמדים הבאים: בני האוכלוסייה הערבית, לרבות הדרוזית והצ'רקסית, מי שהוא או שאחד מהוריו נולדו באתיופיה, נשים, בני האוכלוסייה החרדית, עולים חדשים, אנשים עם מוגבלות - בהתאם להוראות והגדרות חוק שירות המדינה (מינויים), התשי"ט-1959. עדיפות למועמדים תינתן גם בהתאם להוראות ההסכם הקיבוצי של התאגיד מיום 31.3.24. לאוכלוסייה הזכאית לייצוג הולם - כדי לקבל את ההעדפה, יש לציין בעת הגשת המועמדות את דבר ההשתייכות לאוכלוסייה זו בשדה המתאים.

job.title: Project Integration & Service Coordinator
job.snippet:
Looking for a role that combines operations, project coordination, and cross-functional collaboration?
We are looking for a highly organized and proactive professional with strong systems thinking and the ability to drive processes from start to finish. This key role combines project integration across multiple departments with responsibility for coordinating the company's service operations.
Key Responsibilities
Coordinate and align activities between the Engineering, Planning, Marketing, and Operations departments.
Support and monitor projects from the planning phase through execution and delivery.
Manage and track purchase orders with subcontractors and suppliers.
Monitor project timelines, tasks, and overall progress to ensure milestones are met.
Identify bottlenecks and implement solutions to keep projects moving forward.
Manage and coordinate the service team's work schedules.
Plan service calls, prepare work schedules, and assign tasks to field technicians.
Track task completion and provide ongoing support to internal stakeholders.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree or Practical Engineering diploma in Industrial Engineering & Management - a significant advantage.
Previous experience in operations, project coordination, or cross-functional integration - an advantage.
Ability to manage multiple interfaces and priorities simultaneously.
Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail and prioritization abilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a high level of responsibility, customer orientation, and the ability to work independently.

job.title: מומחה/ית תמיכה טכנית לעולם ההדפסה בתלת-ממד  (3D Printing)
job.snippet:
חברת סיסטמטיקס המובילה בפתרונות תלת-ממד בישראל, מחפשת את הכישרון הבא שיצטרף לנבחרת הטכנית שלנו. אנחנו משווקים את המדפסות השולחניות והתעשייתיות המתקדמות בעולם כמו HP, Formlabs, Markforged ועוד ומחפשים מישהו/י שאוהב/ת טכנולוגיות מתקדמות, יצירה ופתרון בעיות מורכבות.
מה כולל התפקיד?
בתפקיד זה תהיה/י הסמכות המקצועית עבור לקוחותינו, החל משלב ההתקנה ועד להדרכה וייעוץ:
מתן מענה טכני וייעוץ (טלפוני ופרונטלי) ללקוחות החברה מהתעשיות המובילות.
התקנה ותיקון מדפסות תלת-ממד שולחניות ותעשייתיות באתר הלקוח ובמעבדת החברה.
העברת הדרכות אישיות וקבוצתיות על תפעול המדפסות, תוכנות ההדפסה ותחזוקה שוטפת.
עבודה מול מרכזי התמיכה והפיתוח של היצרנים המובילים בעולם בחו"ל.
מה אנחנו מחפשים?
רקע טכני: השכלה בתחומי ההנדסה (מכונות/אלקטרוניקה/מכטרוניקה) או ניסיון טכני מוכח מהצבא/תעשייה.
ידיים טובות וראש טכני: ניסיון של שנתיים לפחות בטיפול ותיקון מכונות מורכבות. ניסיון קודם בעולם ההדפסה בתלת-ממד - יתרון.
יכולת הדרכה: כושר ביטוי ויכולת להעביר ידע טכני בצורה ברורה וסבלנית.
אנגלית ברמת קריאה וכתיבה של חומר טכני ותקשורת שוטפת מול חו"ל.
תודעת שירות גבוהה מאוד ויחסי אנוש מעולים ורצון.
עבודה בסביבה טכנולוגית משתנה ומתקדמת.
למה כדאי לכם להצטרף אלינו?
עבודה עם הטכנולוגיות המובילות והמתקדמות ביותר.
סביבת עבודה יצירתית, מקצועית ודינמית.
הזדמנות לצמוח ולהתפתח מקצועית בחברה יציבה ומובילה

job.title: Product Manager
job.snippet:
365Scores isn’t just an app; it’s the digital pulse of sports fans worldwide.
We are looking for a talented, data-driven Product Manager who lives at the intersection of sports, technology, and user experience.
You aren't just writing specs; you’re building the user experience for millions of sport fans. If you can translate complex sports data into a seamless user journey, we might have a fit.
Responsibilities:
End-to-End Ownership: lead the full product lifecycle from initial idea and detailed PRDs to version release and post-launch optimization.
Cross-Functional Coaching: Collaborate with Design, Dev, BI, and Content teams to turn ideas into high-performing features. You will be the focal point that keeps the team aligned.
Data-Driven Growth: utilize user data to define product KPIS and make sure those KPIs are achieved.
Execution Excellence: take full responsibility for the product from start to the "Finish Line" to ensure we ship the best possible version of the product on time.
Requirements:
3+ years of hands-on PM experience managing mobile/web products with rich interfaces and complex real-time data flows.
Pro in writing clear specifications, building wireframes, and conducting market research independently.
A "Go-Getter" who thrives in autonomy. You don't wait for instructions—you identify priorities and execute. Strong organizational and analytical skills, excellent written and oral communication skills
Agility, ability to pivot quickly. In our world, the "score" changes fast, and you need to think on your feet to hit tight deadlines.
AI knowledge, "AI-first" builder who uses generative tools to streamline your ideas into product specifications.

job.title: Finance Specialist
job.snippet:
The opportunity
We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Finance Specialist to support the Finance department in account reconciliations, financial analysis, data validation, and month-end close activities.
How You’ll Make An Impact
Perform balance sheet reconciliations and investigate outstanding items.
Analyze General Ledger accounts and support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Support intercompany reconciliations and resolve discrepancies with global entities.
Review and analyze financial transactions to ensure accuracy and compliance with company policies.
Prepare journal entry support schedules and account analyses.
Assist in statutory audit requests and internal control reviews.
Coordinate with global finance teams on reconciliation and reporting matters.
Your Background
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Economics, or Business Administration.
CPA qualification or CPA track preferred.
2-5 years of experience in Accounting, Audit, Financial Analysis, or Finance Operations.
Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail.
Fluent English, both written and verbal.
More About Us
We offer you the opportunity to work with fantastic people and develop yourself on projects that present great technical challenges and have a real impact.
Publication date : 2026-10-26

job.title: Senior Manager, Customer development - Israel
job.snippet:
Responsibilities
Own end-to-end customer development and project-based sales for energy storage (incl. BESS) projects in Israel; achieve annual signing, collection and key-customer coverage targets.
Build and maintain key-customer and ecosystem-partner relationships (developers, IPPs, utilities, EPCs, consultants, etc.); drive project shortlisting, tendering and award.
Organize bid and commercial negotiations: lead pre-bid clarification, bid strategy, pricing and term proposals; align technical / grid-connection / delivery / legal teams to form executable bid packages and deviation lists.
Drive contract signing and internal handover: ensure clear scope, controllable risks and an executable delivery plan; drive key milestones from signing to delivery.
Track Israel market and policy dynamics relevant to energy storage (regulatory and grid frameworks, tenders/auctions, capacity mechanisms, storage incentives, interconnection approval timelines, etc.); develop opportunity maps and competitive strategies.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or above; preferred majors in power / energy / engineering / business.
6–10+ years of B2B project sales experience in Israel and/or comparable energy storage, power or electrical equipment markets; verifiable track record of wins or key-customer performance.
Familiar with project-based sales processes and key bid/contract terms (performance guarantees, schedule, LDs, scope of grid-connection responsibilities, etc.); cross-functional alignment capability.
Excellent customer management and negotiation skills; able to influence key stakeholders in complex decision chains and drive award.
Fluent Hebrew and English; cross-cultural communication skills; able to travel within Israel and internationally.
Legal authorization to work in Israel.
Preferred
Energy storage / BESS sales experience and relevant local network with developers, IPPs, utilities, EPCs and consultants.
Candidates from a broad range of relevant local companies are encouraged to apply

job.title: Experimental Systems Engineer
job.snippet:
At nT-Tao, we are building a compact magnetic confinement fusion power system: a modular, repeatable unit designed to deliver clean electricity on-site, on- or off-grid. Getting there means solving hard, open problems in plasma physics, and that is the work our physicist's lead.
Founded in 2019, nT-Tao raised $34 million to date from Honda, East X Ventures, Delek US, NextGear Ventures, and others. The Israel Innovation Authority has awarded us repeated grants, most recently to build our next compact fusion demonstrator.
Position Overview
We are looking for a hands-on Experimental Systems Engineer to take ownership of our experimental fusion prototypes, laboratory infrastructure, and supporting systems.
The role combines experimental operations, multidisciplinary system integration, troubleshooting, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
You will be responsible for ensuring that the experimental platform is operational, reliable, and ready to support the company's R&D activities.
Key Responsibilities
Take ownership of the day-to-day operation, readiness, maintenance, and reliability of experimental fusion prototypes and supporting laboratory infrastructure.
Plan, prepare, and conduct experimental campaigns in close collaboration with the physics and engineering teams.
Operate and monitor multidisciplinary systems, including pulsed-power generators, magnetic systems, vacuum systems, cooling systems, RF/microwave equipment, diagnostics, and control systems.
Configure experimental setups, integrate new hardware, and support prototype upgrades and commissioning.
Operate data acquisition and control systems, collect experimental measurements, and ensure data quality, traceability, and proper documentation.
Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, electronic, and control-system malfunctions, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
Develop and maintain experimental procedures, operating protocols, maintenance plans, and safety procedures.
Improve experimental reliability, repeatability, operational efficiency, and system availability.
Coordinate laboratory activities, equipment maintenance, spare parts, suppliers, and technical support.
Work hands-on with engineers and technicians on system assembly, wiring, integration, testing, and repairs.
Required Qualifications and Skills
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering ,Physics, or a related engineering field (M.Sc. an advantage).
4+ years of experience working with multidisciplinary experimental systems, laboratory equipment, or complex R&D prototypes.
Strong hands-on technical capabilities, including system assembly, integration, testing, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
Good understanding of electrical, mechanical, and electronic systems, with the ability to diagnose problems across multiple engineering disciplines.
Experience with laboratory instrumentation, including oscilloscopes, power supplies, signal generators, sensors, and data acquisition systems.
Strong organizational skills, technical ownership, and ability to manage multiple activities and priorities.
Advantages
Experience with high-voltage, high-current, or pulsed-power systems.
Experience with vacuum systems, cooling systems, magnetic systems, or RF/microwave equipment.
Experience with automation, control systems, PLCs, and laboratory software such as LabVIEW or Python.
Experience coordinating experimental campaigns, laboratory operations, or multidisciplinary technical projects.
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a resourceful, independent, and highly hands-on engineer who enjoys working with complex experimental systems and solving practical engineering challenges.
The ideal candidate takes ownership, understands how different subsystems interact, and is comfortable moving between experimental operations, troubleshooting, hardware integration, and coordination with the R&D team.

job.title: Electrical Validation Engineer (contract worker)
job.snippet:
About the Role
Electrical Validation Engineer - Automotive Systems Location: Haifa, Israel Team: Electrical Validation - Quality & Reliability Lab About the Role We are looking for a hands-on, motivated Electrical Validation Engineer to join Mobileye's Quality &Reliability Lab in Haifa. Our team is responsible for electrical validation of advanced automotive ECUs and systems, supporting product development and qualification according to automotive standards and customer requirements. In this role, you will take ownership of electrical validation activities, from test preparation and execution to results analysis, failure investigation, and reporting. You will work closely with hardware, software, and system engineering teams while contributing to test automation and continuous improvement of our lab capabilities.
Responsibilities
Plan, prepare, and execute electrical validation tests according to applicable automotive standards and customer-specific requirements.
Build and maintain electrical test setups, including harnesses, power supplies, electronic loads, measurement instruments, and automotive communication interfaces.
Analyze electrical behavior, waveforms, and test results to identify anomalies, investigate failures, and support root-cause analysis.
Work closely with HW, FW, system engineering, and other validation teams to investigate technical issues and support product qualification.
Take end-to-end ownership of assigned tests, including setup preparation, execution, data analysis, documentation, and reporting.
Contribute to test automation, data analysis, and improvements in validation efficiency.
Support laboratory equipment maintenance, calibration, and continuous improvement activities.
Qualifications
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
Required Skills
2+ years of hands-on experience in electrical testing, validation, hardware integration, or debugging.
Practical experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, and measurement instruments.
Good understanding of electrical circuits, schematics, and electronic systems.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate and solve technical problems independently.
Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
Proactive, organized, and detail-oriented, with the ability to take ownership of tasks and work effectively within a team.
Mobileye | Electrical Validation - Quality & Reliability Lab 2
Preferred Skills
Experience with automotive electrical validation standards and customer-specific test requirements.
Familiarity with automotive communication protocols and interfaces such as CAN, Automotive Ethernet, GMSL, or FPD-Link.
Experience with automotive ECUs, camera systems, radar systems, or embedded electronic products.
Experience with Python scripting, test automation, or automated data analysis.
Experience using automotive development and diagnostic tools.
Experience interpreting technical specifications and translating requirements into validation test procedures.
Pay range and compensation package
Not specified.
About the Company
Why Join Us?• Work on advanced automotive technologies supporting next-generation autonomous driving systems.
Gain hands-on experience with complex electronic systems and modern validation equipment.
Collaborate with experienced engineers across hardware, software, and system development.
Take ownership of meaningful engineering activities and contribute to improving validation capabilities.
Join a collaborative team with opportunities for technical growth, learning, and development.

job.title: Test & Validation Engineer
job.snippet:
We are looking for a hands-on
Test & Validation Engineer
to join our Engineering team at IRP Systems.
In this role, you will be responsible for planning, executing, analyzing, and documenting validation activities for advanced motor controllers and electric propulsion systems.
You will work closely with multidisciplinary R&D teams, including Hardware, Software, Mechanical, and System Engineering, to ensure product performance, reliability, and quality throughout the development lifecycle.
The ideal candidate is a proactive, analytical, and detail-oriented engineer who enjoys hands-on testing, troubleshooting, and continuously improving validation processes.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test procedures, and validation methodologies based on system requirements.
Perform system-level validation and troubleshooting of motor controllers and electric propulsion systems.
Prepare and operate test setups, including dynamometers (Dyno), free-wheeling Dyno systems, and vehicle testing environments.
Configure and operate laboratory equipment, data loggers, and data acquisition systems.
Analyze test data, identify performance issues, investigate failures, and provide clear technical conclusions.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary R&D teams to investigate and resolve critical issues, ensuring product quality and readiness for release.
Create and maintain test documentation, including test procedures, requirements traceability, test results, and validation reports.
Develop and implement test automation tools and scripts to improve testing efficiency, repeatability, and accuracy.
Monitor test equipment readiness, identify technical issues, and support continuous improvement of testing infrastructure.
Coordinate testing activities with internal teams and customers according to project requirements and business priorities.
Requirements:
3+ years of hands-on experience in system-level testing and validation.
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
Proven experience validating multidisciplinary physical products, electromechanical systems, propulsion systems, or related technologies – must.
Proven ability to develop, execute, and document test procedures and technical reports – must.
Experience operating laboratory test equipment, including oscilloscopes, power supplies, digital multimeters, logic analyzers, and motor test benches.
Strong understanding of electromechanical systems and the ability to analyze test results based on physical and engineering principles.
Experience with test automation development and implementation.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and a proactive, hands-on approach.
Fluent English, both written and spoken.
Advantages:
Experience with electric vehicles, motor controllers, inverters, or electric propulsion systems.
Experience with dynamometers, vehicle testing, and data acquisition systems.
Familiarity with CAN communication, data loggers, and CSS tools.
Experience with Python or other scripting languages for test automation and data analysis.
Familiarity with Confluence, SharePoint, or similar technical documentation tools.

job.title: Retailer App Digital Manager
job.snippet:
מנהל.ת מוצר אפליקציית קמעונאים - שוהם
איך יראה היום שלך?
ניהול שוטף של אפליקציית הקמעונאים במטרה להגדיל שימוש, מעורבות והזמנות.
ניתוח התנהגות משתמשים, הזמנות ומכירות, ובניית דוחות ודשבורדים לזיהוי פערים והזדמנויות.
בניית מסעות לקוח והובלת מהלכים מבוססי דאטה לשיפור הפעילות באפליקציה.
תכנון וניהול הפעילות השיווקית באפליקציה, כולל השקות, קמפיינים, תכנים ומסרים לקהלים השונים.
עבודה שוטפת עם מנהלי קטגוריה, שיווק ויחידות עסקיות, כולל בניית גאנט שנתי והוצאה לפועל של התכנים באפליקציה.
הובלת ממשקי העבודה עם תחומי המכירות, יצירת שגרות עבודה, הצגת תוצאות וקידום מהלכים להגברת השימוש באפליקציה.
אחריות על התפעול השוטף של משתמשי האפליקציה ועבודה מול מערכות מידע לטיפול בבאגים ותקלות.
ניהול הממשק המקצועי מול מוקד השירות, כולל תקשור והכשרת הנציגים בעולמות התוכן של המחלקה.
הובלת תהליכי למידה, הטמעה והדרכה של פיתוחים טכנולוגיים ומהלכי חדשנות עבור אנשי המכירות והקמעונאים.
מה חשוב להביא איתך?
השכלה אקדמית בשיווק, כלכלה, מנהל עסקים או מערכות מידע.
לפחות שנה ניסיון בניהול מוצר דיגיטלי או E-commerce.
ניסיון בניהול תהליכים מורכבים ובעבודה מול ממשקים מרובים.
אוריינטציה גבוהה לעולמות הדיגיטל והטכנולוגיה.
היכרות עם תהליכי מכירה בעולם הקמעונאות.
היכרות עם עולמות השיווק, הפרסום ונאמנות הלקוחות.
חשיבה אנליטית, יכולת תעדוף וניהול משימות ועבודה תחת לחץ.
יכולת גבוהה להניע ולרתום ממשקים.
למה שטראוס?
זהו חלק משמעותי בחיבור בין דיגיטל, מסחר, שיווק ומכירות. העשייה בתפקיד מחברת בין דאטה והתנהגות משתמשים לבין מסעות לקוח, פעילות מסחרית והטמעת חדשנות טכנולוגית בקרב אנשי המכירות והקמעונאים.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer – Autonomous Command & Control Platform
job.snippet:
We are building the
core infrastructure and operating system for autonomous platforms
.
Our platform enables real-world autonomous operations by coordinating drones, docking stations, edge systems, operators, and external systems in real time. It serves as the operational backbone for mission execution, command and control, communication, telemetry, orchestration, and fleet coordination across distributed autonomous environments.
This is not a typical backend role.
You will work at the intersection of
distributed systems, Command & Control (C2), autonomous platforms, and real-world operations
.
We are looking for engineers who are comfortable entering complex and unfamiliar systems, quickly understanding how they work, and turning operational concepts into clean software models and architectures.
You should enjoy reasoning about
entities, relationships, state, events, commands, missions, resources, and system boundaries
— and designing software that represents and coordinates them reliably.
The platform includes:
Command & Control capabilities for autonomous systems
Fleet orchestration and mission lifecycle management
Real-time communication between distributed autonomous components
Modeling and management of operational entities, states, and relationships
Telemetry, video, and operational data processing
Device interoperability across heterogeneous autonomous platforms
SDKs and APIs for platform integration and extensibility
AI agents and intelligent automation interacting with operational systems
As a Senior Engineer, you will help shape the technical foundation and domain architecture of the platform while solving complex problems across distributed systems, autonomous operations, and Command & Control.
Responsibilities:
Design and build software systems for autonomous platform operations and Command & Control
Translate complex operational requirements and domain concepts into robust software architectures
Model operational entities, relationships, state transitions, commands, events, and workflows
Lead architecture and system design decisions across services, communication layers, and domain boundaries
Build scalable, low-latency, resilient production services
Design reliable communication and messaging flows between distributed system components
Solve complex challenges involving concurrency, scalability, latency, synchronization, and fault tolerance
Build abstraction layers for integrating heterogeneous autonomous devices, platforms, and external systems
Develop internal SDKs, APIs, and reusable infrastructure components
Design systems that can be consumed and operated by humans, autonomous components, and AI agents
Improve observability, debugging capabilities, and operational reliability
Drive engineering best practices, clean architecture, and code quality standards
Explore new technologies and approaches when existing solutions are not sufficient
Requirements:
Strong experience building complex production software systems
Strong proficiency in at least one of Java, Python, or C++
Strong software engineering, system design, and architecture fundamentals
Experience with distributed, event-driven, or real-time systems
Understanding of concurrency, networking, messaging, state management, and failure handling
Experience modeling entities, relationships, states, events, and workflows
Experience with communication technologies such as RabbitMQ, gRPC, WebSockets, or similar
Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to design, develop, debug, and improve software
﻿Ability to quickly understand unfamiliar technologies and complex systems
Strong ownership and independent problem-solving skills
We care more about
how you understand complex systems, model real-world problems, and make architectural decisions
than about specific frameworks or tools.

job.title: Research And Development Engineer
job.snippet:
Position:
Advanced R&D Engineer
About us
LTS is a leading pharmaceutical technology company that develops and manufactures innovative drug delivery systems for the pharmaceutical industry.
LTS´ commercial offering encompasses more than 20 marketed products.
LTS operates today from 5 sites: Netanya (Israel), Adrenarche (Germany), West Caldwell (NJ, USA), St. Paul (MN, USA), and Shanghai (China).
About the role
We are looking for a highly motivated and creative
Advanced R&D Engineer
to join our
New Technologies
team in Israel.
This is a multidisciplinary R&D position focused on transforming innovative ideas into next-generation drug delivery technologies and medical devices, from initial research and concept generation through feasibility assessment, proof of concept, and technology maturation.
The position is full time, office/ hybrid.
Direct Manager: VP New Technologies
Responsibilities:
Translate unmet needs and early ideas into engineering concepts, proof-of-concept systems and functional prototypes. Establish initial performance requirements and characterize critical engineering parameters.
Research, investigate and develop new drug-delivery concepts, technologies and device architectures. Participate in brainstorming, technical reviews and innovation workshops.
Explore new approaches for wearable and on-body drug delivery, injection systems and other advanced delivery technologies.
Conduct engineering feasibility studies and create technical recommendations for further technology development. Understand and investigate interactions among device, drug/container, delivery mechanism and user.
Investigate technologies and mechanisms relevant to drug delivery, including fluid delivery, actuation, pumping, drive mechanisms, sensing, drug-container interfaces and patient-device interfaces. Analyze experimental data and translate findings into design improvements and technical decisions.
Evaluate emerging technologies, materials, components, suppliers and technical solutions for potential integration into future LTS platforms.
Develop mechanical concepts, mechanisms, assemblies, and device architectures. Designing components for injection molding, machining, and additive manufacturing while applying DFx principles to enable robust and manufacturable solutions.
Apply structured problem solving and root-cause analysis to complex technical challenges. Document design rationale, experiments, results, conclusions and recommendations.
Build, assemble, test and troubleshoot prototype devices in a hands-on R&D environment. Design experimental setups, fixtures and test methods.
Support the transition of successful technologies into formal product-development projects.
Job Requirements:
Education:
B.Sc.\ M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering or Biomedical Engineering.
Candidates with a Biomedical Engineering degree should have demonstrated hands-on experience in mechanical design and/or medical-device development
Job skills:
2-5 years of R&D/product-development experience, preferably in medical devices, drug-delivery devices or another multidisciplinary regulated product environment.
Hands-on experience developing physical products from concept through prototype and testing. Experience designing and executing engineering experiments, solving multidisciplinary engineering problems.
Familiarity with medical-device regulations, human factors/usability-related device development, design controls and applicable standards is an advantage but is not mandatory.
Experience involving any of the following is a significant advantage: Wearable or on-body drug-delivery devices, autoinjectors, pen injectors or injection systems, pumps or miniature fluid-delivery systems, disposable medical devices.
Good understanding of mechanical mechanisms, fits, tolerances and interfaces. Understanding of manufacturing technologies and material selection. Knowledge of GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis is an advantage.
Ability to independently design and execute engineering experiments.
Experience in developing prototypes and test fixtures
Strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis capabilities. Ability to analyze experimental data and draw engineering conclusions.
Knowledge of statistics and Design of Experiments (DOE) is an advantage.
Computer skills:
Strong 3D CAD capability, preferably SolidWorks or equivalent.
Proficiency in MS Office and AI tools for research, data analysis, technical documentation, and engineering problem-solving; experience with statistical/DOE and simulation tools is an advantage.
Language skills:
Has excellent English communication and technical-writing skills.
Personality:
At LTS, we value collaboration, innovation, and accountability.
We're looking for individuals who can:
Is curious by nature and passionate about innovation and technology. Has a strong CAN-DO attitude.
Enjoys creating something that does not yet exist. Thinks critically and challenges existing technical assumptions. Learns new scientific and engineering domains independently.
Can take an unclear technical problem and transform it into a structured engineering investigation.
Is highly hands-on and enjoys laboratory and prototype work.
Is creative but also disciplined and data-driven. Takes ownership and drives technical tasks independently.
Communicates clearly with multidisciplinary teams.
Is comfortable working in the uncertainty typical of early-stage technology development.

job.title: Integration Technician – Part-Time JB-5624
job.snippet:
Metacentric is a well-funded startup operating in the field of underwater applications: autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and advanced underwater sensing. Following a successful recruitment round, we are building the next generation of AUVs and the sensing payloads they carry, with the goal of redefining how the world perceives and operates in the underwater domain.
The role includes: assembling and operating our AUVs, from the first cable on the workbench to a vehicle performing missions at sea.
Responsibilities:
• Building, wiring, and assembling cable harnesses, connectors, and power distribution for the vehicle and its support equipment.
• Assembling and integrating AUV subsystems (thrusters, batteries, sensors, navigation, communications, and payload) within pressure housings and the vehicle frame.
• Testing and troubleshooting circuits and subsystems using laboratory equipment, and continuously updating schematics and wiring diagrams.
• Preparing, sealing, and pressure-testing housings, penetrators, connectors, and cables for underwater use.
• Preparing vehicles for missions and supporting sea trials, including launch and recovery.
• Performing maintenance, repairs, and post-mission inspections, and maintaining clear documentation of the work.
• Technician or practical engineer in electronics, robotics, or mechatronics, or equivalent training – required
• 2–3 years of hands-on experience building electrical harnesses and assembling electronic or electromechanical systems – required
• Wiring, soldering, and connector skills, and the ability to read electrical schematics and wiring diagrams – required
• Experience working with laboratory equipment: oscilloscope, multimeter, power supply, and signal generator – required
• A flexible, multidisciplinary approach and willingness to work in the field, including sea trials – required
• Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUV), ROV, or other unmanned vehicles – advantage
• Experience in the defense, aviation, or maritime industries – advantage
• Underwater connectors, sealing, and pressure housings – advantage
• Lithium batteries, BMS, and motor controllers – advantage
• PCB design, microcontrollers, and embedded systems – advantage
• ESD, EMC, and EMI – advantage
• Boating or skipper license – advantage

job.title: Technical Integrator – SRE
job.snippet:
We’re looking for a
Technical Integrator – SRE
to help ensure the stability, reliability, and performance of a large-scale financial application in a production environment.
What you’ll do
Serve as the central interface between development teams, infrastructure, operations, maintenance teams, and external vendors.
Investigate and resolve complex production incidents.
Build and maintain monitoring and alerting systems, perform data-driven Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and drive reliability and performance improvements.
Leverage AI tools such as Claude and Kiro to improve troubleshooting, automation, and operational workflows.
What we’re looking for
Strong technical motivation, initiative, and self-learning capabilities.
Hands-on experience in technical integration across development, infrastructure, operations, and external vendors.
Practical experience with Splunk and Dynatrace for production monitoring and troubleshooting.
Experience setting up monitoring systems, dashboards, and alerts.
Database experience with MongoDB, DocumentDB, and SQL.
Familiarity with OCP and AWS environments.
Familiarity with AI-powered development and operations tools, such as Claude and Kiro — a significant advantage.
Strong collaboration skills and a continuous-improvement mindset.
High ownership, independence, organizational skills, and service orientation.

job.title: מהנדס.ת מרכז מחקר לייצור מתקדם בבנייה
job.snippet:
תיאור התפקיד:
למכון הלאומי לחקר הבנייה דרוש.ה מהנדס.ת מרכז מחקר לייצור מתקדם בבנייה.
התפקיד משלב עבודה הנדסית ומחקרית לצד עבודה מעשית שוטפת במעבדה, הכוללת הכנת תערובות, תפעול ציוד מתקדם, ביצוע ניסויים ופיתוח תהליכי ייצור חדשניים.
יישום והובלת פרויקטים ומחקרים בתחום הייצור המתקדם בבנייה, בדגש על הדפסות תלת־ממד בבטון ובחומרים נוספים.
תכנון וביצוע ניסויים, ביצוע סימולציות ואופטימיזציה לתהליכי הדפסה.
תפעול מערך רובוטים, מדפסות תלת־ממד, משאבות וציוד מעבדתי ייעודי.
הכנת תערובות חומרי גלם והפעלת מערכות ערבוב ושאיבה.
ביצוע בדיקות מעבדה ואפיון חומרים ורכיבים מודפסים.
פיתוח ושיפור שיטות עבודה, תהליכים ומתקנים ייעודיים למחקר ולייצור.
הדרכת סטודנטים, חוקרים ומשתלמים בעבודה במרכז.
אחריות על תפעול שוטף של המרכז ותחזוקת הציוד.
עבודה בהתאם לתקני איכות, נהלי עבודה ונהלי בטיחות.
דרישות התפקיד:
תואר ראשון בהנדסת מכונות או בהנדסה אזרחית, ארכיטקטורה ממוסד אקדמי מוכר.
ידע וניסיון בתחום הריבוד (הדפסה תלת־ממדית), לרבות ניסיון מעשי בתהליכי הדפסה.
ניסיון בעבודה מעשית עם ציוד מעבדתי, מערכות ייצור או ציוד טכני מתקדם.
ניסיון בתכנון וביצוע ניסויים.
יכולת טכנית גבוהה, יצירתיות, כושר ארגון ויכולת עבודה עצמאית.
נכונות לעבודה פיזית ולביצוע משימות מעשיות כחלק בלתי נפרד מהפעילות השוטפת במרכז.
שליטה מלאה בעברית ובאנגלית.
ניסיון בעבודת מחקר ופיתוח, לרבות עבודה מול התעשייה – יתרון משמעותי.
ניסיון בהדרכת סטודנטים, משתלמים או משתמשי מעבדה – יתרון משמעותי.
היכרות עם תהליכי הכנה ושאיבה של תערובות בטון וחומרים נוספים – יתרון.
רישיון להפעלת מלגזה וציוד הרמה – יתרון.
הערות:
המשרה בהיקף 100%.

job.title: Robotics Software Engineer
job.snippet:
Skana Robotics is a defense-tech startup building the future of the maritime domain through autonomous systems and fleet-level software. We operate at the fascinating junction of AI, robotics, and the sea. We build both hardware and software, featuring an amazing team and a hangar full of autonomous vessels.
We’re looking for a Robotics Software Engineer to design, build, and maintain core components of our robot software stack. You’ll work across the perception, planning, and controls pipeline, integrate with hardware and sensors, and help take features from prototype to production deployment.
This is a hands-on engineering role. You’ll write production code, debug on real hardware, and collaborate closely with the mechanical, electrical, and product teams.
What You’ll Do:
Design and implement software components across the robotics stack — perception, state estimation, motion planning, navigation, and control.
Integrate and interface with sensors (cameras, IMU, encoders, etc.) and actuators.
Build and improve the robustness of autonomy features so they hold up in real-world conditions, not just simulation.
Develop tooling for simulation, testing, logging, and data replay to speed up iteration and debugging.
Diagnose issues on physical hardware — from timing and latency problems to sensor calibration and edge-case failures.
Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code, and participate in design and code reviews.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (mechanical, electrical, product) to define requirements and ship features to deployment.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on robotics.
Strong proficiency in C++ and Python.
Hands-on experience with ROS or ROS 2.
Solid grasp of core robotics concepts: coordinate frames and transforms, kinematics, sensor fusion, and at least one of perception, motion planning, or control.
Comfort working with real hardware — debugging on-device, reading logs, reasoning about timing and real-time constraints.
Strong problem-solving instincts and the ability to own a problem end to end.
Nice to Have:
Experience with a robotics simulator (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or similar).
Background in one or more of: SLAM, state estimation (EKF/UKF), path planning, or trajectory optimization.
Experience with real-time or embedded systems (RTOS, microcontrollers, low-latency control loops).
Exposure to computer vision or ML for perception (OpenCV, PyTorch, point cloud processing).
Experience taking a robotics product from prototype to field deployment.
Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and deploying software to fleet hardware.

job.snippet:
We're Hiring |
Senior Systems Engineer – Robotics & Autonomous Systems
📍
Location:
Netanya, Israel | Additional opportunity in Northern Israel
Axioma
develops advanced technological solutions in robotics and autonomous systems. As we continue to grow, we're looking for experienced and talented engineers to join our R&D team.
If you're passionate about cutting-edge technology, enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, and want to make a real impact in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Serve as a Systems Engineer within multidisciplinary projects focused on robotics and autonomous systems.
Develop and maintain system engineering documentation, including system requirements specifications, interface definitions, and system design documents.
Support system integration, verification, and validation (V&V) activities.
Participate in field testing, system evaluations, and analysis of test results.
Collaborate closely with software, electronics, and algorithm development teams.
Conduct technology assessments and market research to identify relevant technologies and solutions.
Requirements
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline – Mandatory.
At least 6 years of experience in Systems Engineering or a relevant engineering field – Mandatory.
Strong systems-level thinking and the ability to understand complex, multidisciplinary systems.
Excellent technical documentation and communication skills.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to learn new technologies independently.
Good command of English, both written and spoken.
Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative, team-oriented mindset.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience with sensors, UAVs, or autonomous systems.
Experience integrating sensors and weapon systems into vehicle platforms – a significant advantage.
Familiarity with Command and Control (C2) systems.
Experience developing systems incorporating Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies.
Technical military background.
Valid security clearance.
Additional Information
Two positions are available for immediate hire.
The positions are based at our offices in Netanya, in the Kiryat Sapir Industrial Zone, within walking distance of Netanya Sapir railway station.
One of the positions also involves working at a facility in the Galilee region, making it suitable for candidates based in Northern Israel.

job.title: Applied AI Engineer
job.snippet:
About Windward
Windward is the leading Maritime AI™ company, fusing data and Generative AI to empower global leaders with mission-grade intelligence. We help organizations anticipate threats and make high-stakes decisions with confidence.
About the Role
This is a role for someone who wants to help build the org of the future, where agents and people work side by side. A strong software engineer who wants to own complete solutions rather than one piece of a larger system. You'll be expected to figure out how to solve the problem and make it work.
The work includes two aspects:
Vertical solutions — build and ship agents and applications for teams across Windward. Often you'll be the sole engineer on a project — scoping it, architecting it, shipping it to production.
Org-wide solutions — build the shared products and infrastructure that AI runs on across Windward. The work compounds: what you ship here makes every downstream agentic effort faster and better.
Your Mission
Build the internal agentic capabilities that change how Windward works — both the org-wide solutions that everything else connects to, and the vertical solutions that make our teams measurably better at their jobs.
How The Team Works
We move fast, ship continuously, and care more about outcomes than titles or process. If you have a bias for action, enjoy being hands-on, and naturally prioritize value, this is the team for you.
What You'll Do
Take a problem from "fuzzy" to "shipped" — work from a rough definition and a priority, and figure out the rest.
Architect, build, and ship AI agents, applications, and intelligent workflows end-to-end. Integrate AI solutions with company data, APIs, and internal systems.
Rapidly prototype and experiment with new AI technologies, turning successful concepts into reliable production solutions.
Embed with internal users — sit with the team, watch how they work, map the process, build what fixes the highest-leverage part.
Own the build end-to-end — architecture, implementation, evals, logging, deployment.
Debug the non-deterministic — when a system fails on edge cases, you build the evals and guardrails to catch it rather than reading logs by hand.
Stay honest about what AI can and can't do — scope realistically, ship reliably, don't overpromise.
Who You Are
First and foremost, you’re a software engineer who loves building.
3+ years as a software engineer. You've shipped products that people used.
You code AI-native — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, whatever you've landed on — and you can read what the model writes and tell whether it's good. Python and Node are your regulars.
An all-around full-stack builder, not a coder. You have a product mindset, can hold a complex platform architecture in your head, and you can also walk into a department, talk to users, and ship a solution without a detailed ticket telling you what to build.
Hands-on experience designing, building, and evaluating production-grade LLM and agentic AI systems, including tool calling, RAG, MCP, workflow orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.
You have great intuition and pragmatism, knowing when to build, integrate, automate, or leverage existing tools. Curiosity and a strong bias toward experimentation and shipping.
Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud environments. You can scope a system without hand-waving.
English at a professional level.
Advantage
You've founded a company or built something solo that real people used.
Experience with workflow automation and integration platforms (e.g., n8n, Workato, or similar).

job.title: Business Applications Manager
job.snippet:
Description
Personetics is shaping the Cognitive Banking era, harnessing AI to help banks anticipate customer needs, provide actionable insights, and deliver intelligent financial guidance. Our platform continuously analyzes and leverages real-time transactional data, enabling banks to proactively support customers in managing their finances and reaching their goals.
As industry leaders — yes, we really are leaders — we partner with the world’s top financial institutions, empowering over 150 million customers monthly across 35 global markets from offices in New York, London, Singapore, São Paulo, and Tel Aviv.
About The Position
Personetics is looking for a Business Application Manager to own our SaaS and business application portfolio end to end, and to lead how AI is actually implemented inside it.
This is the bridge role between IT and the business. The person in this role makes sure every system we pay for is used correctly, by the right people, at the right depth, and drives the practical rollout of AI and agentic AI across our internal systems and processes.
It is a hands-on role that combines three disciplines: system administration, business application ownership, and AI implementation and governance, Reports to the Head of IT.
Because we serve banking and fintech clients, this role operates inside a regulated environment. Access control, data handling and audit evidence are part of the day job, not an afterthought.
Responsibilities
Monitor business system health, resolve integrations, API, sync, and availability issues, and escalate to vendors when needed.
Ensure that we fully utilize existing systems by activating unused features, optimizing configurations, and automating manual processes. Permission model (role-based access, JML, SSO/SCIM, access reviews)
Self-service request and approval workflows
SaaS inventory, overlap mapping, consolidation and decommissioning
Evaluate and approve new tools across technical fit, security/compliance, and commercial value. Manage vendors, renewals, and licenses.
Partner with departments to translate business needs into system configurations, automations, and integrations.
AI implementation and agentic AI governance
Requirements
5+ years in business applications, SaaS operations, including hands-on ownership of at least three business platforms end to end - configuration, integrations and permissions, not first-line support.
Hands-on administration of a work management platform such as Monday.com, Jira or Asana: building boards, automations, integrations and permission structures.
Strong Microsoft 365 administration with real depth in SharePoint Online - site architecture, permissions, document management and lifecycle.
Proven experience designing and enforcing access and permission models, including SSO and SCIM or directory-based provisioning.
Practical experience implementing AI tools and AI-driven automation in a business environment, with a track record of streamlining real processes and showing the time or quality gain.
Experience working directly with business departments and translating their needs into system solutions.
Project management skills: able to run a multi-stakeholder implementation or migration from scoping through rollout and adoption, managing timelines, dependencies, vendor coordination and stakeholder communication. Formal certification is not required.
Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Hebrew.
NICE TO HAVE
Experience with SaaS management platforms such as Torii or Zluri.
Hands-on experience with enterprise LLM platforms and agentic AI - Claude Enterprise, MCPs, connectors or agent frameworks.
Experience leading a system consolidation or migration project.

job.title: Head of Customer Experience & Success
job.snippet:
Spines: #1 Fastest-Growing Book Publishing Platform in the U.S.
At
Spines
, we’re rebuilding publishing for a new era: powered by technology.
Our next-generation publishing platform combines powerful AI with human expertise to help writers publish professionally across every format, language, and global market. The tools we’re developing streamline editing, design, translation, production, and distribution, making a complex process simple, scalable, and author-first.
Our mission is to make professional publishing possible for everyone, so no great story goes unheard. But what we’re really building is bigger: a platform that transforms how books are made, shared, and experienced globally.
We’re growing a team of people who want to shape the future of publishing: creators, technologists, and storytellers driven by craft, purpose, and the opportunity to make a real impact for authors and readers everywhere.
Ready to build what comes next and rewrite the future? Apply now.
About the role:
In this role, you will lead a complex, cross-functional service operation, establish scalable infrastructure and processes, manage and grow teams, and prepare the company for substantial scale- growing from hundreds to thousands of authors.
We are looking for a strategic leader with strong execution capabilities and a proven track record in hyper-growth environments, who can seamlessly balance operational excellence, advanced technology, and a high-touch, premium customer experience.
Key
Responsibilities
:
End-to-End Ownership: Own the entire author journey and customer experience, from initial onboarding to final book publication.
Scale & Leadership: Lead and scale the Customer Experience & Success department to support rapid business expansion.
Process & Infrastructure Design: Build, optimize, and implement scalable operational workflows capable of supporting thousands of active authors concurrently.
Team Management & Development: Lead, mentor, and grow Customer Success teams to align with company growth targets.
Author Journey Management: Design onboarding frameworks, proactive communication strategies, expectation management, and ongoing author support.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with editing, design, production, and operations teams to establish smooth handoffs and collaborative workflows.
Performance Metrics (KPIs): Define, monitor, and optimize key performance indicators, including CSAT, response times, SLA adherence, and service quality.
Tech & Automation: Drive operational efficiency through process automation, CRM implementation, and the integration of AI tools.
Escalations & Continuous Improvement: Identify bottlenecks, manage critical escalations, and continuously elevate the overall author experience.
Service Excellence: Set and maintain a service standard that blends personalized care, professionalism, and full transparency throughout the journey.
Requirements:
5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, or Customer Operations.
3+ years of people management experience, including managing managers or team leads.
Proven track record leading customer/service operations during periods of rapid, high-scale growth- a Must.
Demonstrated experience building scalable processes, infrastructure, and systems transitioning from hundreds to thousands of customers.
Experience managing long-term, multi-stage, complex customer journeys involving multiple touchpoints.
Deep experience in B2C customer management and cultivating long-term client relationships.
Proven background in CRM implementation, process automation, and data-driven operations.
Strong analytical mindset with proven experience managing by KPIs and performance metrics.
Demonstrated ability to lead change, resolve complex issues, and optimize operational workflows.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, high empathy, and strong expectation-management abilities.
Self-directed and proactive, combining high-level systems thinking with a hands-on approach.
Advantages
Experience in B2C companies characterized by long-cycle, complex customer journeys.
Proven experience building or significantly expanding a Customer Success organization from early stages.
Background in EdTech, professional services, premium/concierge services, or project-based service industries.
Familiarity with the publishing or content creation industry.

job.title: Data Analytics Engineer (Maternity Cover)
job.snippet:
Datarails is the AI operating system for finance teams. We unite financial and operational data through FinanceOS, the trusted data layer for finance, and build the applications, workflows and AI experiences finance teams use to run the business.
We are looking for a
Data Analytics Engineer
with strong technical skills to join the Marketing Data team. You will be the go-to person for how Marketing and other teams measure what matters. You will define the metrics, build the analysis behind them, and keep the data underneath them reliable.
Our marketing data model on BigQuery is already in production. You will report to the VP Growth and work directly with Marketing, Product and Sales leaders.
What You'll Do
Work with Revenue leaders to turn business questions into clear metric definitions, KPIs and measurement plans.
Build analysis and dashboards on acquisition, conversion, activation, feature adoption and retention.
Identify gaps in tracking and work with R&D to close them.
Maintain and extend existing pipelines and models (Airflow, Fivetran, ad platform connectors, BigQuery transformations).
Monitor data quality and fix issues before they reach stakeholders.
Document metric definitions, models and decisions as you go.
Requirements
Must have
3+ years as an analytics engineer or data analyst, preferably in B2B SaaS.
Experience defining metrics and KPIs with business stakeholders, and specifying and building the dashboards that track them.
Experience working across business domains (such as marketing, sales, product or finance), and quickly learning a new team’s data and questions.
Proficiency in SQL and Python for data processing, analysis and automation.
Data modeling and warehousing experience in a cloud data warehouse, ideally BigQuery on GCP.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines from multiple sources, orchestrated with Apache Airflow.
Ownership of data observability: pipeline health, freshness and quality.
Git
and version-controlled development (branches, pull requests, code review), with familiarity with CI/CD, Docker and Terraform.
Works independently: can take a loosely defined question, scope it, and deliver without close technical supervision.
Nice to have
Marketing analytics background: attribution, funnel and campaign performance.
Data modeling and pipeline experience with tools such as Fivetran, Funnel.io or dbt.
Familiarity with HubSpot and Salesforce data structures.
Understanding of SaaS metrics (ARR, churn, CAC, LTV).
Experience with Looker Studio or another BI tool.

job.title: Junior Technical Support Engineer
job.snippet:
Who are we
We are here to improve lives by restoring sight worldwide by a robotic platform for vision saving surgery. Our company will improve the way ophthalmic surgery is delivered to vision impaired individuals now and for decades to come.
We are rapidly growing, funded by leading international VCs, and are looking to expand our small, motivated, multi-disciplinary and phenomenal team. Joining us is an opportunity to work towards saving vision across the globe, collaborating with others to realize a dream, and tackle an enormous challenge that will help drive your career forward.
Who we are looking for
We are looking for a Technical support to join our growing robotics startup. This role is hands-on and multidisciplinary, involving installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and on-site support of complex robotic systems. The systems combine mechanics, hardware, electronics, and advanced software, and require strong system-level understanding. The position includes work at our company’s facilities as well as international travel, primarily for system installations, demos, and field troubleshooting. As part of our rapidly growing, small, motivated, and multi-disciplinary team, this position is the first dedicated role in its domain, providing a unique opportunity to contribute to a new area within the company.
Responsibilities
Maintain, test, and troubleshoot robotic systems at the company’s facilities.
Install, calibrate, and commission robotic systems at customer and partner sites abroad.
Lead on-site system setup and troubleshooting during demos and early deployments.
Diagnose and resolve hardware, mechanical, and software issues in the field.
Perform hands-on replacement and repair of mechanical and electromechanical components.

Who are we
We are here to improve lives by restoring sight worldwide by a robotic platform for vision saving surgery. Our company will improve the way ophthalmic surgery is delivered to vision impaired individuals now and for decades to come.
We are rapidly growing, funded by leading international VCs, and are looking to expand our small, motivated, multi-disciplinary and phenomenal team. Joining us is an opportunity to work towards saving vision across the globe, collaborating with others to realize a dream, and tackle an enormous challenge that will help drive your career forward.

The systems combine mechanics, hardware, electronics, and advanced software, and require strong system-level understanding. Job Description
הצטרפו לצוות שמאחורי מותגים אייקוניים כמו Huggies® ®, , Depend®
בקימברלי-קלארק, הכל כאן בשבילכם , חדשנות, צמיחה והזדמנות לעשות השפעה אמיתית.
נוצרת כדי ליצור טיפול טוב יותר לעולם טוב יותר: זו ההזדמנות שלך להפעיל מכונה שמייצרת מוצרים מהשורה הראשונה לרבע מאוכלוסיית העולם. תזכה להכרה לעיתים קרובות על ידי המנהל שלך, לתמוך בצוות שלך, ולראות את המוצרים שאתה מייצר משמשים את המשפחה שלך בסופו של דבר. זה מתחיל איתך.
עליך:
באחד מתפקידי הייצור שלנו, תתמקד בניצחון עם הצרכנים והשוק, תוך שמירה על בטיחות, כבוד הדדי וכבוד האדם במרכז.
תחומי אחריות עיקריים:
הפעלת המכונה
הזנת חומרי גלם
פתרון תקלות
תחזוקה בסיסית
אחריות על סדר וניקיון בסביבות העבודה.
התנהלות ישירה מול מנהל המכונה ומחלקות האחזקה במקרים של תקלות.
כדי להצליח בתפקיד זה, תצטרך את ההסמכות הבאות
השכלה – 12 שנות לימוד.
ניסיון קודם בהפעלת מכונה – יתרון.
משרה מלאה במשמרות בוקר צהרים ולילה
רישיון מלגזה – חובה
ניסיון של שנה לפחות
עבודה בשלוש משמרות : שבוע בוקר 07:00-15:30 , שבוע ערב 15:00-23:30 , שבוע לילה 23:00-07:30 ,
בנוסף עבודה בימי שישי )כשעובדים משמרת בוקר באותו שבוע ) - 07:00-12:00
ומוצ"ש - כשעובדים באותו שבוע משמרת לילה 23:00-07:30
בהובלת מטרה. מונע על ידך.
הטבות:
קליטה לחברה מהיום הראשון
סביבת עבודה תומכת ומתגמלת
סל רווחה - מתנות בחגים , ימי כיף לעובדי החברה
חדר אוכל פעיל במפעל
מערך הסעות מהאזור
להגשת מועמדות
לחץ/י על כפתור הגשת מועמדות והשלם/י את הגשת המועמדות שלך. צוות הגיוס שלנו יבחן את הבקשה שלך ויהיה איתך בקשר אם נראה שאת/ה מתאים/ה לתפקיד זה.
בינתיים, אנו מזמינים אותך להיכנס לאתר אתר הקריירה שלנו, שם תוכל/י למצוא מידע נוסף ומשרות נוספות.
האותיות הקטנות:
כדי שקימברלי-קלארק תמשיך לצמוח ולשגשג, עלינו להיות ארגון המיישם את הניסיון המגוון של חברי הצוות שלו למותגים שמשפרים את חייהם של אנשים ברחבי העולם. אנו פועלים באופן פעיל לבניית כוח עבודה מגוון המשקף את חוויות הצרכנים שלנו. כאשר את/ה מביא/ה את החשיבה המקורית שלך לקימברלי-קלארק, את/ה תורמ/ת להצלחה המתמשכת שלנו. אנו מחויבים להיות מעסיק שוויוני המאפשר לכל המועמדים המתאימים לקבל הזדמנות להעסקה ללא קשר לגזע, צבע, דת, מין, מוצא לאומי, מצב נכות, מעמד ותיק מוגן, נטייה מינית, זהות מגדרית, גיל, הריון, מידע גנטי, מעמד אזרחי או כל מאפיין אחר המוגן על פי חוק.
ההצהרות הנ"ל נועדו לתאר את האופי הכללי ורמת העבודה המבוצעת על ידי עובדים המשויכים לסיווג זה. ההצהרות אינן מיועדות להיחשב כרשימה ממצה של כל החובות, האחריות והכישורים הנדרשים לתפקיד זה.
Primary Location
Afula Plant
Additional Locations
Worker Type
Employee
Worker Sub-Type
Regular
Time Type
Full time

job.title: HR & Facility Manager
job.snippet:
Innodata is looking for an experienced
HR & Facility Manager
to lead our local HR operations, employee experience, and workplace management in Israel.
This is an exciting opportunity for an HR professional who enjoys combining strategic partnership with hands-on execution, working closely with local leadership and global teams in a dynamic, growing, international technology environment. The position is
fully remote (based in Israel)
with periodic presence at the
Jerusalem
office.
Key Responsibilities
HR Leadership:
Lead local HR operations and partner with global HR leadership to align local practices with global policies and business objectives.
Employee Relations & Compliance:
Advise managers on employee matters, performance management, and employment practices, ensuring compliance with Israeli labor laws.
Employee Experience:
Drive employee engagement, organizational culture, onboarding, and initiatives that strengthen connection across a predominantly remote workforce.
HR Operations & Payroll:
Oversee employment documentation, payroll coordination, and local employee benefits.
Workplace & Facilities:
Manage the Jerusalem office, facilities, vendors, budgets, and employee equipment.
Team Leadership:
Lead and develop a small team responsible for HR, administration, and operational support.
Global Collaboration:
Work closely with international stakeholders across HR, Finance, IT, and other functions to support business growth and global initiatives.
Requirements
At least 5 years of experience in HR management.
At least 2 years of experience in facilities or workplace operations management.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or a related field.
Excellent communication skills in Hebrew and English.
Strong organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams and time zones.
Strong knowledge of Israeli labor law and employee relations.
Experience in performance management, employee engagement, and HR operations.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a multinational technology or professional services company.
Experience supporting remote or distributed teams.
Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, and workflow automation tools.
About us
With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, Innodata is the AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 7 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, law, and medicine. We’re at an exciting stage in the company and fortunate in these times to grow our team.
We’re an equal opportunity employer.
Only relevant applicants will be contacted

job.title: Planning & Merchandising Manager
job.snippet:
Irani Group, the exclusive franchise partner of lululemon in Israel and Europe
About the Role
lululemon is growing across Israel and Europe, and we are looking for a
Planning & Merchandising Manager
to take full ownership of the financial and commercial performance of our product assortment.
In this role, you will be accountable for category-level sales targets, gross margin, markdowns, inventory turnover, and Open-to-Buy (OTB) management, while shaping the merchandising strategy: what to buy, how much, where, and when, across all our markets.
This is a senior, independent role with no direct reports at this stage, offering true end-to-end ownership, from pre-season planning through in-season execution.
At its core, this is a highly analytical position focused on building models, forecasts, and data infrastructure that drive commercial decisions, while continuously connecting the numbers to what is happening on the sales floor.
Reporting & Key Stakeholders
The role reports to the
Head of Buying & Commerce
and serves as the financial and analytical counterpart to our category buyers across Women's, Men's, and Accessories & Footwear.
You will work closely with Visual Merchandising and store teams across our markets, spanning Israel and 12 European markets.
Key Responsibilities
Pre-Season Planning
Develop category-level pre-season financial plans in partnership with buyers, covering sales, markdowns, margins, receipts, and inventory.
Lead buying and assortment strategies, including depth versus breadth, size runs, price architecture, and entry price points, tailored to each market.
Take full ownership of OTB, translating sales targets into the right purchasing quantities at the right time.
Develop seasonal product flow strategies that maximize sales, profitability, and customer experience.
In-Season Management
Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly performance, identify risks and opportunities, and respond in real time.
Lead the monthly planning review process, including re-forecasting sales, markdowns, and receipts.
Manage inventory levels and balance stock across stores and countries to optimize product availability, sales, and margins.
Lead pricing and markdown decisions throughout the season.
Analytics & Business Insights
Analyze historical data and emerging trends to develop strategies that deliver financial targets.
Build and continuously improve financial models, forecasts, and reporting tools, creating an analytical foundation for the entire commercial organization.
Lead seasonal hindsight reviews, translating key learnings into current and future plans.
Conduct detailed analysis of size runs, local sales patterns, store-to-store performance, and color and style trends.
Allocation, Merchandising & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Take full ownership of allocation, including store-level inventory planning and the development of data-driven store plans and OTB budgets.
Partner with Visual Merchandising to ensure product assortment, presentation, and in-store storytelling align with the commercial strategy.
Deliver clear, actionable reporting and analysis to senior management, connecting financial performance with what is happening on the sales floor and throughout the supply chain.
What Makes This Role Unique
This is not a traditional planning role within an established, fully structured organization.
This is a builder role in a fast-growing business.
You will have the opportunity to establish and shape the planning and merchandising infrastructure for lululemon, understand new markets with evolving consumer behaviors, and navigate the real complexity of operating across multiple countries and currencies.
It is a unique opportunity to define how planning and merchandising operate as a global brand scales across international markets.
Requirements
At least
4 years of proven experience
in Merchandise Planning, Buying, or Allocation within a retail organization. Experience in multi-store fashion or lifestyle retail is a significant advantage.
Strong analytical thinking and financial modeling capabilities, including forecasting, simulations, and advanced Excel proficiency.
Proven ability to transform raw data into actionable insights and clear business recommendations for management.
Strong understanding of core merchandise planning principles, including OTB, gross margin, inventory turnover, receipts and inventory planning, and markdown management.
Exceptional attention to detail, combined with the ability to see the bigger picture.
A proactive, resourceful, and independent mindset, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and take full end-to-end ownership.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken, for ongoing collaboration with the global brand and European store teams.
Nice to Have
Experience working in an international or multi-market environment, including multiple currencies and markets.
Familiarity with merchandise planning systems or Business Intelligence (BI) tools.
Experience using AI tools as part of daily workflows, including data analysis, forecasting, and process automation.
Experience working with a global brand or within a franchise business model.
Who You Are
Entrepreneurial:
You continuously innovate and find new ways to achieve exceptional results.
Honest & Caring:
You communicate openly and thoughtfully, creating an environment where others feel empowered to do the same.
Courageous:
You lead with confidence, knowing that the possibility of greatness outweighs the fear of failure.
People-First:
You put people first and build relationships based on trust.
Accountable & Humble:
You take full personal responsibility for your work and results, while never taking yourself too seriously.
